label: human (Center Command 2v4)
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (34, Cortex bots, start A3) and [gecko]u6bkep (19, Armada vehicles, start B5); spectators [gecko]Covariance and computer_whisperer (the user, hosting)
our_side: Four seats in the east box: t2 Cortex H7 (seat 0), t3 Armada H1 (seat 1), t4 Cortex G4/G5 forward (seat 2), t5 Cortex H5 the tier-2 sprint seat (seat 3); Opus 5.5 medium players under an Opus 5.5 high side commander; hands Jev 1.14.0; lobby names MonkeyLord, obliterator, Amojini, [D]4RK_HUNT[E]R
summary: Our four seats held more tier-1 extractors (27 to 19 at 7:00) and 1.6-8.5x the two people's army from 2:00 to 13:00 (2.2-2.3x at 8:00-10:00, the sum of our four records against the replay's truth), and lost at about 21:05 on the tier-2 economy. The commander's plan (one sprint seat fed by the other three) was sound, but the sprint was fed as surplus: t5 placed its advanced vehicle plant at 4:15 on 9 metal a second, received 450 metal in nineteen minutes and had it standing at 7:39 (3:24 against thebluegecko's 1:46); its advanced constructors went out one at a time, the second idled three minutes on the Armada seat (a harness fault), and the side had 1 moho at 12:00 against their 8. The people sprinted as one team from 7:08 (one advanced bot lab, constructors shared across factions, mohos in 19-33 s with helpers, each advanced plant eaten for the next) while thebluegecko's commander crept heavy turrets into our north at E1-E2 from 6:24, took t3's outer spots and later put his forward advanced plant, two fusions and a Beamer-and-Sheldon nest there. Our army lead was spent in separate bodies, t2 trading at D7 and C6 in the south and t3 losing about 7,700 metal for about 200 in four attacks on the F2-F3 nest (13:11-16:06), and it flipped at 15:00 (7,460 against 10,285); from 17:00 Stouts, Tzars, Sheldons, a Negotiator and Wasps on about four times our income overran t4, t3 and t5 in turn.

root.what: The tier-2 sprint was starved from the minute it was placed. t5 put its advanced vehicle plant down at 4:15 on 4 extractors (9.4 metal a second) while the three feeding seats spent everything on tanks (stores at 0-50) and were asked only for surplus ('every 150 metal that builds up', 0:20 and 4:50). 450 metal reached t5 before 19:32, the plant stood at 7:39, and the moho race was lost 1 to 8 by 12:00. The person's reading (the user) and the commander's own post-mortem point here; the army-lead reading is a turning point below.
root.evidence: record-3: '4:15 created coravp 5539', '7:39 finished coravp 5539'; t2 note 5:29: 'right now it sits at 0-50 on 13 income ... nothing to send yet'; metal to t5 before 19:00: 200 + 250. The user: 'several exposed mistakes in how our team t2 mex buildout progresses vs the humans'

His forward advanced vehicle plant (12:38), fusions (18:00, 18:18) and the Beamer-and-Sheldon nest later stand on that ground.

our_mistakes.what: The commander asked the feeders for surplus ('send metal you don't need', then 'every 150 metal that builds up') while their plants spent as they earned, so no surplus existed; the feeders built about 12,000 metal of tanks and 2,000 of turrets in minutes 4-12 (ledger). A stronger side fixes the sprint's share as production: a standing rate per seat, a paused plant per seat, or every spare constructor on the frame (the user's ruling 2026-10-20: feeding is production, not surplus). Harness side: no standing transfer existed.
our_mistakes.evidence: commander direct 4:50: 't2, t3 and t4 each send t5 every 150 metal that builds up in their store'; metal to t5 before 19:00: the commander's 200 at 4:50 and t4's 250 at 5:34 (its 5:14 call refused: 'from and to are seat tags'); feeders' stores 0-180 at 5:00-13:00 (analyze curves)

our_mistakes.what: t5 kept the first advanced constructor for its own four mohos against the commander's order (first three to t3, t2, t4), and every moho was built by one advanced constructor at an empty store: 2:16 for the first, 1:31 for the second, against the people's 19-33 s with helpers. The user's ruling: start the frame, pass the constructor on, let tier-1 build power finish it.
our_mistakes.evidence: t5 note 8:14: 't5's first advanced constructor (constructor_28669) stays home to upgrade t5's 4 spots to mohos first'; record-3: cormoho 9:09->11:25, 11:29->13:00

His commander was alone at E2 for minutes (a snipe chance t3 named twice) and his tech window passed untouched.
our_mistakes.evidence: commander 9:20: 'We have lost 5,400 metal to his 2,200 because our bodies met his blocks one at a time'; t3 note 6:24: 'If allied armies came north, his commander at E2 is the prize.'

our_mistakes.what: t3 attacked the F2-F3 nest four times with tier 1 (Beamers 490 reach, Sheldons 850) instead of going around or waiting for an answer that outranges it; about 7,660 metal lost for about 215.

their_play: Two people on about 12 spots each played the sprint as one team. thebluegecko (Cortex) placed his advanced bot lab at B3 at 7:08 on 11 extractors and a 1,165 bank and reclaimed his tier-1 lab the same second; it stood at 8:54 and made five advanced constructors by 10:15 (ledger), the second given to u6bkep, who built Cortex mohos with it from 9:47. Mohos went up at 19-33 s each from 9:27 with two advanced constructors and tier-1 helpers in parallel (ledger; finished: 8 at 12:00, 12 at 13:00, 34 at 21:00, replay truth), and nano farms grew to 73 construction turrets by 21:00. Each advanced plant was eaten for the next: the bot lab reclaimed at 13:20 for an advanced vehicle plant placed forward at E2, in our half (12:38, standing 13:22), that one reclaimed at 18:44 for an advanced air plant (18:52); fusions at 18:00 and 18:18, also at E2-F2. In the field his commander led a heavy-turret creep from D2 to E1-E2 from 6:24 that took our north spots; Beamers held C5 and F2; u6bkep's Stout and Janus block (with Thugs and Blitzes early) fought our south at C5-D7 and later E7-G5; Sheldons with a jammer at F3 from 13:13, Tzars, a Negotiator, Mausers and Wasps (from 19:36) finished it. Side income per the ledger: theirs 55, 106, 250, 277 at 8:00, 12:00, 15:00, 20:00 against ours 59, 56, 63, 56.

defects.defect: Whether the loss rests on a since-fixed defect: in part. The cross-faction fault cost one of four advanced constructors three minutes and t3's mohos, and the missing standing transfer let the feed stay at 450 metal; both were fixed 2026-10-20. The gap at 12:00 (8 mohos against 1) was set mostly by the allocation (strategy).

bears_on.note: The people ate their tier-1 lab the second the advanced lab was placed (corlab 470 lost at 7:08) and moved each plant on; our feeders kept massing tier 1 (side army 8,747 at 13:00) while the sprint starved.
Side army 1.6-2.3x from 6:00 to 13:00 (2.2-2.3x at 8:00-10:00, during his tier-2 build) was never converted; it flipped at 15:00 (7,460 vs 10,285).
The commander at 9:20: 'our bodies met his blocks one at a time'; t3 fought the E2 post alone, t2 the south alone, t3's tier-1 attacks on the F2 nest came one after another.
Four attacks on the strongest position (the F2-F3 Beamer-and-Sheldon nest) lost about 7,660 for about 215; Wasps came at 19:36 with no anti-air at t3 or t5.
One construction turret on our side all game against 73 of theirs by 21:00; our mohos took 1:31-2:16 on one constructor, theirs 19-33 s with helpers.
Decided on extractors minutes before the overrun, here on mohos (8 vs 1 at 12:00, 21 vs 7 at 17:00) while we led tier-1 extractors 27-19 at 7:00.
thebluegecko's commander stood alone at E2 from 6:24 (t3: 'his commander at E2 is the prize'); the side never converged on it.
As a general rule only: the people built 31 converters by 17:00 on Center Command; the lesson was said of metal-heavy Comet, so this is a scope note, not a refutation.

lens.caveats: No truth file in the match directory (a people game) and the per-match tools read only record-0 (t2); I built scratch directories pairing each record-N with the engine replay's truth-(N+2) from run/matches/1792466765-replay-center-command-2v4b (unit ids match), so side totals are my sums of the four seat rows and 'his' is both people together. pro_baseline not run (not Comet). wake_read is hard-wired to record-0/strategist-0, so seats 1-3 ran through renamed links. floor's noop%/jev$ are blank on the scratch dirs (seat 0 as recorded: noop 42%, jev$ 0.28). chat.jsonl has no lines for this game and the records carry only the host's banners: the user's words come from the ledger and commits a2fd043/2e395b2, not from in-game chat. The humans' income and lab clocks to the second are the ledger's (the main session's replay read); mohos, nanos and plants by minute are mine from the replay truth. The root choice (economy over the unconverted army lead) follows the user and the commander; the army reading is mine.

open_questions: In a 4v2 with about 6 spots a seat, was matching the tier-2 sprint right, or would one combined body on his E2 post and B3 lab during 7:08-10:00 (side army 2.2-2.3x) have ended it first? The review skill's F7 says the scenario decides; this game does not settle it.
Would t5 sending its first advanced constructor out at 8:50 as ordered have helped, given that the first recipient in the commander's order was the Armada seat that could not use it?
How much of the wreck metal named in the wake reasons (up to 12,064 at t2) was ever reclaimed?
Did the 2026-10-20 fixes (standing transfer, start on a list step, cross-faction constructors) change the moho clock in a later team game? (unmeasured as of the memory)
